name: code_parallel_verification_report
description: Deterministic code_parallel decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

branch.description: Branch name shown in the report header; rendered as '(none)' when falsy.

commit.description: Commit SHA shown in the report header; rendered as '(no commit)' when falsy.

issues.description: Plan validation issues, rendered one per bullet line; each object's string 'message' field is used if present, else its JSON, else its stringified form.

merged.description: Branches merged; only the count is rendered.

outcome.description: Verification outcome (e.g. code_parallel_verification_outcome output); only its 'planValid' and 'executionOutcome' fields are rendered.

report.description: Human-readable verification summary: branch/commit, plan validity, merge count, execution outcome, and a bulleted list of plan issues.
